August has arrived, and many deals remain hot, including $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and an all-time low on AirTag 2. But today's top story in the 9to5Toys "afternoon picks" is the M5 MacBook Air—we spotted a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, while the official Apple Certified Refurbished store is also offering up to $300 off several configurations, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details here). Beyond the above deals, there are also nearly $100 off various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest black Beats 240W Braided USB-C cable for just $18, and a chance to snag the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $40. Details below.

August AirPods deals with up to $100 off: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2 and more starting from $99

  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (regular price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regular price $129)

Best Buy launches August Back to School deals: Apple products, smart TVs starting from $80, dorm upgrade offers and more

Official Apple Refurbished Store now selling the M5 MacBook Air at the lowest price ever, with up to $300 off

A new round of price increases has already taken effect at the retail level for the MacBook lineup, and although we've been tracking deals with up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering the best discounts on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've previously highlighted the lowest-priced base model from reputable sellers, and now you can also pick up the 24GB 15-inch model in Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue for $300 off retail.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is currently selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,699, with free shipping. As mentioned above, this offer applies to all four colors: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air is priced at $1,900, and currently every configuration on Amazon is selling for over $1,999.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (regular new price $1,299) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (regular new price $1,599) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (regular new price $1,999) — $300 off

Today's Apple Refurbished deals bring the price of this machine back to pre-price-hike levels, the best discounts we've seen since the price increase took effect. It looks like these new suggested retail prices will hold through the end of the year, and possibly longer. So while this isn't the all-time lowest price we've tracked, for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year, this is definitely a money-saving opportunity worth grabbing—you'll likely have to wait until later in 2027 to see the new MacBook Air lineup at this price point again.

Head to the Apple Refurbished Store now to browse all MacBook deals—use the filters on the left side of the page to select the model you want.

Cheapest 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air drops $200 today

Ongoing: Amazon today offers up to a massive $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro

The MacBook just had a price hike, but Amazon this morning is still offering up to a massive $500 off the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro. This price is very close to the best price we saw before the price increase took effect. Details below.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,499, with free shipping.

Considering this machine is priced at $2,999 at Apple and other retailers, that's effectively a $500 discount. This offer applies to Space Black and Silver models.

Since the price increases took effect at major retailers, this is the best deal we've seen on the M5 Pro model.

Before this, Amazon's best discount on this machine was $300, but this time it's an extra $200 off.

Although it hasn't yet matched the price we tracked for this configuration before the price hike, this is reality—this is its price. Taking everything into account, and bearing in mind this machine only had a major price hike about a month ago, this deal is only $100 above the all-time low we've seen on this M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models drop nearly $100 on Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has also lowered prices on other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium case model with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band, with nearly $100 off. Details below.

While Series 11 models have had steady deals, as in early August, discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 are rarer. But this morning we spotted Amazon selling the black Ultra 3 with the black "One Size Fits Most" Ocean Band for nearly $100 off.

Amazon is currently selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the black Ocean Band for $699.99, with free shipping.

Regularly priced at $799, this nearly $100 discount is the best new-unit deal we've been able to find from reputable retailers.

Aside from the brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this is one of the best deals of the year, and one of the few notable price drops we've seen on Amazon.

At the time of writing, the black model with Ocean Band is the only configuration enjoying a significant discount. But if this offer follows the previous pattern, we expect to see other color configurations gradually drop in price throughout the day and week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with black Ocean Band $700 (regular price $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (regular price $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (regular price $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (regular price $899)

If you want to buy the Series 11, you can now get it for far less than those prices:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (regular price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (regular price $429)

Latest black Beats 240W Braided USB-C cable drops to new all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off)

Today's chance to grab the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41

We were very impressed with the Solo Buds' built-in battery life—this is the cheapest current Beats wireless earbuds under the Apple brand. Regularly priced at $80, Amazon usually sells them for $70, but if you can get them for $41 with free shipping from Best Buy, it's an even better buy. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals here, more Solo Buds deals below.

Best Buy is currently selling "excellent condition" open-box transparent red Beats Solo Buds for $40.99, with free shipping. That's nearly half the suggested retail price, and far less than Amazon's $70 for new units.

  • Looks and functions like new.
  • All accessories and attachments included. Packaging may vary or be missing.

You're indeed looking at a more entry-level pair of earbuds, but we note that this is a current pair of earbuds under the Apple brand, priced at just $41.

As mentioned above, we tested it ourselves and confirmed the built-in battery provides up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. Although it doesn't come with a wireless charging case with a battery, for most users at this price of $41, this battery life is quite sufficient. Other features include one-touch pairing, a custom microphone with an "advanced noise-cancelling learning algorithm" for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
